<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Electoral Evolution:</strong> On the 80th Independence Day, reflections on India’s democratic journey highlight the significant transformation of the Lok Sabha and electoral processes since 1947.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
